kaps_punt: Paaie en voetpaadjies - hoe hulle in nedersettings gebruik word

items.bewering: Elke pad loop êrens heen
items.bron: Universal, but true: a road by definition links points (even a dead end leads to the places along it). Consistent with the network descriptions in the Western Cape Road Network Information System (rnis.westerncape.gov.za), which classifies every proclaimed road by the places it connects (trunk, main, divisional, minor).

items.bewering: So verbind paaie, strate en voetpaadjies al die plekke binne 'n nedersetting. 'n Groter pad loop by die nedersetting uit en verbind hom met die volgende dorp.
items.bron: Western Cape RNIS (rnis.westerncape.gov.za): the network is organised into trunk, main, divisional and minor roads, the higher classes linking towns and the lower ones serving local access; SANRAL November 2025 briefing to the CSIR Road Pavements Forum (rpf.csir.co.za, SANRAL-Updates-RPF-November-2025) describes the national/provincial/municipal hierarchy. Illustrative generalisation, sound for Grade 4.

items.bewering: Kinders loop skool toe of ry met 'n bus of 'n minibus-taxi.
items.bron: Stats SA, National Household Travel Survey 2020 (statssa.gov.za/?p=14054 and the NHTS 2020 presentation): about 10.1 million learners (59.4%) walk all the way to school; taxis and buses are the main other modes. South African source on local practice.

items.bewering: Grootmense ry werk toe en koop later kos by die winkel. Iemand wat siek is, ry met dieselfde pad na die kliniek toe.
items.bron: Stats SA NHTS 2020 (statssa.gov.za/?p=2493): work and shopping trips by taxi, bus and car are core travel purposes in the survey; the sentence is illustrative and not exclusive (it does not say all adults drive). No checkable error.

items.bewering: Vragmotors bring die winkel se kos en die kliniek se medisyne aan.
items.bron: SAnews (sanews.gov.za/node/32662), Gauteng Health: stock from the provincial Medical Supplies Depot is delivered to clinics and hospitals by enclosed, lockable, tracked trucks; SAnews (sanews.gov.za/node/30868), North West: distributors transport stock from the depot to facilities. Road freight of retail food is the norm.

items.bewering: Langs baie strate loop daar 'n voetpaadjie vir die mense wat stap.
items.bron: 'Baie strate' is a safe quantifier (not 'elke'). Word meaning: the Dutch cognate voetpad/voetpaadje covers both a footpath and a paved walkway beside a road (wiktionary.com/wiki/voetpad; GEMET 'footpath', eionet.europa.eu/gemet concept 3395). No Afrikaans dictionary entry was reachable online to confirm whether 'sypaadjie' is the more usual Afrikaans word for a street-side walkway; that is a word-choice question for the language step, not a truth question, and the lesson's own begrip ('waar mense loop en nie motors ry nie') fits both uses.

items.bewering: Op die voetpaadjie loop jy veiliger as tussen die motors.
items.bron: FHWA-RD-01-101 (pedbikeinfo.org/resources/resources_details.cfm?id=51): presence of a sidewalk associated with an 88% lower likelihood of a 'walking along roadway' pedestrian crash site; FHWA CMF Clearinghouse (cmfclearinghouse.fhwa.dot.gov/study_detail.php?stid=665): crash risk ratio 1.67 times higher where there is no sidewalk.

items.bewering: Ander paadjies vat 'n kortpad oor grond waar geen pad loop nie. Mense het baie sulke paadjies net uitgetrap deur elke dag daar te loop.
items.bron: Desire paths: University of Wisconsin news (news.wisc.edu/desire-paths-the-unofficial-footpaths-that-frustrate-captivate-campus-planners/) and Geography Realm (geographyrealm.com/what-are-desire-paths/): informal trails worn by repeated foot traffic, usually as shortcuts where no built path runs.

items.bewering: Nie elke pad is van dieselfde materiaal gemaak nie.
items.bron: SANRAL November 2025 RPF briefing (rpf.csir.co.za): of about 750 000 km of road, about 158 000 km is paved and the rest gravel or earth; Western Cape RNIS distinguishes surfaced, gravel, and earth roads and tracks.

items.bewering: 'n Teerpad is glad en sterk en dra gewoonlik die meeste verkeer.
items.bron: Western Cape Government, Infrastructure (westerncape.gov.za/infrastructure/node/1507): 'Of the just over 32 000 km of provincial road in total, 20% is surfaced but this 20% carries 95% of all traffic.' The hedge 'gewoonlik' is appropriate.

items.bewering: Jy kry teerpaaie in die strate van dorpe en stede.
items.bron: SANRAL November 2025 RPF briefing: metros hold 66 143 km of road of which 51 682 km is paved. The sentence says tar roads are found in towns and cities, not that every town street is tarred, so the many gravel township streets do not contradict it.

items.bewering: Die meeste groot paaie tussen dorpe is ook geteer.
items.bron: SANRAL November 2025 RPF briefing (rpf.csir.co.za): the national road network is 27 478 km, of which 26 956 km (about 98%) is paved; Western Cape (westerncape.gov.za/infrastructure/node/1507): the surfaced 20% of provincial roads carries 95% of traffic. Holds because it is limited to 'groot paaie'. Note for the writer: it would be false widened to all roads between towns, since only about 16% of provincial roads (41 825 of 267 581 km) are paved; do not drop 'groot' in a revision.

items.bewering: 'n Gruispad is van klein klippies gemaak en dra gewoonlik minder verkeer as 'n teerpad.
items.bron: Gravel road composition (wikipedia 'Gravel road'; extension guidance): crushed stone, sand and fine binder, with stone the main load-bearing part, so 'klein klippies' is an acceptable Grade 4 simplification. Traffic: Western Cape (westerncape.gov.za/infrastructure/node/1507): only about 5% of vehicle kilometres are travelled on gravel roads.

items.bewering: Gruispaaie loop dikwels in landelike gebiede tussen die plase.
items.bron: SANRAL November 2025 RPF briefing: about 79% of South Africa's road network is gravel, the bulk of it provincial rural roads (provinces 267 581 km, only 41 825 km paved); Western Cape RNIS: about 10 300 km of proclaimed gravel trunk, main and divisional roads.

items.bewering: 'n Grondpad het nie teer of gruis nie en bestaan net uit grond. So 'n pad word sag en modderig wanneer dit baie reën.
items.bron: Western Cape RNIS distinguishes 'earth roads and tracks' (about 16 000 km) from gravel roads; Mt Elias KwaZulu-Natal school-travel study (Frontiers in Sociology 2026, 10.3389/fsoc.2026.1751964) records muddy, slippery roads in the rainy season as a hazard for learners.

items.bewering: Verkeer en geld bepaal saam waarvan 'n pad gemaak word. Teer kos baie geld, en party besige paaie bly daarom nog jare lank gruis.
items.bron: Visser, 'Warrants for upgrading gravel roads to bituminous standard' (CSIR/NITRR, trid.trb.org/View/283607): the decision is economic and driven chiefly by traffic volume and costs; DUT thesis on KZN gravel-to-paved prioritisation (openscholar.dut.ac.za/handle/10321/4867): budgets fall short of upgrade needs; Western Cape (westerncape.gov.za/infrastructure/node/1507): important gravel roads such as the Merweville Road are surfaced over time as backlogs are reduced.

items.bewering: Reën, swaar vragmotors en hitte slaan met die jare slaggate in 'n pad.
items.bron: CSIR, 'Summer rains to lead to more potholes' (csir.co.za/summer-rains-lead-more-potholes-csir-warns): water is the primary cause, with heavy traffic and poor maintenance; CSIR non-technical pothole material: 'ageing and drying of binder', 'worsened by the increase in heavy vehicles'; RAC (rac.co.uk/drive/news/motoring-news/intense-summer-sun-will-lead-to-even-more-potholes/): UV and heat oxidise bitumen so it hardens and cracks, letting water in. 'Met die jare' correctly conveys that it is gradual.

items.bewering: 'n Slaggat kan 'n motor se band of wiel stukkend maak.
items.bron: MIWA via The Citizen motoring (citizen.co.za, 'Have you experienced pothole damage to your car?', 2022): in 80% of cases the rim is damaged; IOL 2006 (iol.co.za, 'Bad roads: you can claim for damages'): claims for rim damage and realignment.

items.bewering: Mense op fietse en kinders wat stap, sukkel ook deur die gate en die modder. So word die pad na die skool, die werk en die kliniek moeiliker en gevaarliker. Dit vat langer en kos meer moeite om by daardie plekke te kom.
items.bron: Mt Elias KZN school-travel study (Frontiers in Sociology 2026): muddy roads linked to fatigue, lateness and absenteeism; Business Report 2023-10-16 'Rural hopes for education face tough road with mobility challenge'.

items.bewering: Ná swaar reën is party paaie so sleg dat niemand daaroor kom nie.
items.bron: Daily Maverick 2026-01-20 'Floods derail start of 2026 classes in Limpopo and Mpumalanga': hundreds of schools cut off and scholar transport unable to cross; Benoni City Times 2023-11-27: learners miss school on rainy days because of the state of the roads. The absolute 'niemand' is bounded by 'party paaie' and holds.

items.bewering: Elke gebied in ons land val onder 'n munisipaliteit wat na daardie gebied kyk.
items.bron: Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996, s 151(1) (gov.za Chapter 7): 'The local sphere of government consists of municipalities, which must be established for the whole of the territory of the Republic.' The universal 'elke' is correct.

items.bewering: Die munisipaliteit hou die plaaslike strate en paaie in stand.
items.bron: Constitution Schedule 5 Part B lists 'municipal roads' as a local-government functional area (referred to in OUTA's AARTO Constitutional Court filing, outa.co.za, and the Municipal Fiscal Powers and Functions Act, source.acts.co.za); SANRAL November 2025 briefing: municipalities and metros hold about 323 000 km of road. The limit to 'plaaslike' is right: national and provincial roads belong to SANRAL and the provinces. Keep that word if the block is revised.

items.bewering: Sy werkers stop slaggate en maak 'n gruispad weer gelyk.
items.bron: News24 Kouga Express 2017-11-29 'New plan for gravel roads': the municipality hires a grader to grade gravel roads town by town; Grocott's Mail 2015-08-13 'Potholes: we're fixing them, says muni'. Municipal roads are mostly gravel (SANRAL 2025: 37 680 of 256 903 km of municipal road paved), so a municipality grading a gravel road is accurate.

items.bewering: voetpaadjie: 'n Smal paadjie waar mense loop en nie motors ry nie.
items.bron: GEMET thesaurus 'footpath' (eionet.europa.eu/gemet concept 3395): a narrow path for pedestrians only; Dutch cognate voetpad/voetpaadje (wiktionary.com/wiki/voetpad).

items.bewering: teerpad: 'n Pad wat met 'n harde swart laag teer bedek is.
items.bron: UP repository, 'Bitumen rubber chip and spray seals in South Africa' and SATC seal papers: South African surfaced roads carry a black bituminous binder layer (often with stone chips) that waterproofs the road; Kruger Park Times 'Road resealing' (krugerpark.co.za): strictly, modern roads use bitumen from crude oil, not coal tar, but 'tar'/'teer' is the everyday South African name for that surface (contractors advertise 'tar surfacing' for bitumen work). 'Teer' is the established everyday word and the definition holds at Grade 4. If a later lesson teaches what tar is made of, it should not say that roads are covered in coal tar.

items.bewering: gruispad: 'n Pad wat met klein klippies bedek is in plaas van teer.
items.bron: Gravel road wearing course: crushed stone with sand and fines as binder, with stone the main component (wikipedia 'Gravel road'; extension guidance on gravel road surfaces); Western Cape RNIS: unsurfaced proclaimed roads are 'commonly referred to as gravel roads'.

items.bewering: grondpad: 'n Pad sonder teer of gruis, waar mense op die grond ry.
items.bron: Western Cape RNIS: 'earth roads and tracks' as a category separate from surfaced and gravel roads.

items.bewering: slaggat: 'n Gat wat in die oppervlak van 'n pad oopgebreek het.
items.bron: Tensar white paper 'What causes potholes' (tensar.co.uk): surface cracks, water and traffic combine until small blocks of surfacing break free and a pothole forms; CSIR 'Summer rains to lead to more potholes'. 'Oopgebreek' matches the mechanism.

opsomming: Elke bewering in die les is nagegaan en hou stand; die les bevat geen vergelykings nie, en die enkele hoogste-graad- en alle-uitsprake ('die meeste verkeer', 'die meeste groot paaie', 'niemand', 'elke gebied') is bevestig, maar 'groot' in 'die meeste groot paaie tussen dorpe' en 'plaaslike' in die munisipaliteitsin dra elk die waarheid van die sin en mag in 'n hersiening nie wegval nie.
